about_the_game:
Try the first 7 days of Cosmic Coop and get a taste of relaxing farm life with your new Critterling friends. Grow crops, craft simple items, decorate your garden, and watch adorable creatures visit your little patch of paradise.

This demo lets you experience the cozy core loop: plant, harvest, attract Critterlings, and start building your dream ecosystem — all without stress.

What’s included:

  • Play through the first 7 in-game days

  • Meet a few adorable Critterlings

  • Grow crops and craft basic items

  • Decorate your farm with early decorations

  • Relax and preview the cozy atmosphere of the full game

We hope you enjoy this small peek into the world of Cosmic Coop!

short_description: Attract cute Critterlings, build a thriving garden, craft decorations, and relax in a cozy, creature-collecting farming sim. Grow crops, design your farm your way, and watch adorable visitors bring your peaceful world to life.
